metadata.name: Smart Home Live Semantic Evaluation — 200 Cases
metadata.purpose: Live-LLM semantic robustness evaluation for ambiguity, context, clarification, long conversation, negation/cancellation, stale-context isolation, and event-based memory.

scoring_guidance.overall_pass: A case passes only if the decision is correct and the semantic goal preserves all required targets, constraints, negations, and context references.
hard_fail_conditions: unsafe action caused by guessing unresolved information
rejected value consolidated as a positive long-term preference
stale context incorrectly applied to a new topic

metadata.catalog_note: Map room/device names to the project's real registry before treating grounding failures as semantic failures. Cases using 'current_room' assume a runtime focus/location exists.
